text:
Riya: Quick sync: we need to finalize the May webinar format and routing. Options: (A) Benchmark talk + panel + short demo clip (60m) or (B) Interactive lab (90m). Pros/cons?
Noah: A scales better for lead gen and less risk. +1 for a demo clip not live.
Priya: A too. We can show the latency chart and a 3min recorded runtime clip.
Diego: Ops: if clip, upload to CDN 48h prior and keep a fallback recording. Also registration needs SF mapping.
Riya: Decision: format A with one demo clip. Panel of 3: PM, Eng, Customer. Volunteers?
Noah: I'll be Eng. I can build the benchmark slides and the demo clip.
Priya: I'll do PM and draft the abstract + slide template. Will post draft by Wednesday EOD.
Sam: I'll own customer outreach and blog recap post. Target customer who can speak to cost reduction.
Diego: Registration -> Salesforce queue: Webinars/Product/Inbound owner sam@redwood. Hidden field interest=benchmarks; tag attended_demo when they click demo CTA. Webhook payload for form redirect: POST /lead-capture { "source": "webinar_may", "queue": "Webinars/Product/Inbound", "owner": "sam@redwood" }
Riya: Timeline: slides due 48h before live; rehearsal one week prior. Proposed rehearsal Thu 15:00 next week. Works for everyone?
Noah: Thu 15:00 ok.
Priya: OK, reserving slot and will send invite.
Riya: Run-of-show draft in rehearsal invite. Promo: email invite + two reminders, LinkedIn posts, blog with gated prompt set to reproduce benchmarks. Sam will own blog and gated assets.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: rehearsal invite to be sent at 2450012350.
Riya: Thanks team. Priya pls post final abstract here once ready. If blockers, flag in this thread. :rocket:
